message:
You know those moments when you feel a little smug about being prepared? We had one recently when a sudden storm rolled in, and we were cozy at home with our go-bags packed and our emergency plans ready. 

As the wind howled outside, we couldn’t help but chuckle a bit. It felt nice to know we had our essentials all sorted while some of our friends were scrambling to find flashlights and batteries. 

It reminded us that being prepared isn’t just about having supplies; it’s about peace of mind, too. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying ready at home?
